arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Vergeer stated Lee never had a chance to present witnesses.
She claimed these witnesses could establish his innocence.
Mr. Wilson argued compliance with Rule 24 does not require tracing through the record.
He stated Lee presented his claims all at once to the trial judge.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Remon Lee serves life without parole for first-degree murder. He claims witnesses can prove his innocence. The state says he did not follow court rules. The Court must decide if his claim fails.
